Overview

Sunyani is a city in Bono with a population of 120,000. The capital of the Bono Region, a clean and well-planned city known for its greenery and agricultural research. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 22.0.
